response.justification: The candidate has 14+ years of broad software engineering experience, a CS degree, and genuine depth in full-stack and some high-throughput systems work (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests/sec in D). However, the resume shows no evidence of the core requirement for this role: designing and operating experimentation platforms, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical/experimental analysis. There is also little demonstrated principal-level (IC6) scope — no multi-workstream initiatives across teams and products, no enterprise-scale platform ownership, and limited evidence of data-driven growth measurement. Strengths in craftsmanship, testing, OSS leadership, and teaching are real but do not offset the domain gap for a Principal Growth/Experimentation role.
strengths: 14+ years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, with CS degree
Low-latency, high-throughput microservices experience (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, OSS tooling, public teaching/talks
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature flagging, or bias/rollout-risk experience shown
No telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis background evidenced
Scope reads senior/staff IC rather than Principal — limited cross-team, multi-product platform leadership

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of engineering experience at scale
